recommendation: Keep the audit commit as an external-repo decision. If the exact warning severity or acme.com exemption needs refinement, make that change in Kindling / org.hl7.fhir.core validator or IG Publisher source and then consume the updated dependency from this repository.
issue_request: FHIR-20761 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core. It requested validation of Identifier.system and Coding.system values in core and HL7-published IG examples so that non-example systems resolve to CodeSystem or NamingSystem definitions; the final resolution made this a warning rather than an error.
initial_application: No current FHIR source commit explicitly references FHIR-20761. The active Gradle build runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the external Kindling dependency, and the legacy Ivy file also references external org.hl7.fhir.validation artifacts, so the enforcement point is outside this source checkout.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-27 record discussion of FHIR-20761 as a tooling/data-gathering item assigned to Grahame using IG Publisher. Current active core resources still include acme.com/example.org example systems, while external org.hl7.fhir.core validator source contains the NamingSystem, example/acme URL, and unknown-code-system handling that governs this behavior.
reconciliation: No FHIR source files were changed. A local edit to examples would exceed the Jira resolution, and a local edit to the FHIR checkout would not implement the HL7 IG Publisher behavior.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to warn when core or HL7-published IG examples use non-resolved code system URLs outside example.org/acme.com.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request as publisher/validator warning behavior rather than a required source cleanup of all examples.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record FHIR-20761 discussion and assignment to Grahame to start gathering data using IG Publisher.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms the issue was handled as IG Publisher/core-build tooling work, not as an immediate edit to specific example files.

evidence_items.summary: The current FHIR checkout pins Kindling as an external dependency and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from that dependency; legacy Ivy also references external org.hl7.fhir.validation.
evidence_items.learned: The current build delegates the requested validation behavior to external tooling, so there is no authoritative in-tree source file to edit for the rule.

evidence_items.summary: External validator source contains NamingSystem loading, example/acme URL handling, and unknown-code-system validation logic in BaseWorkerContext, ValidationEngine, and InstanceValidator.
evidence_items.learned: The implementation evidence and any needed severity/exemption refinement belong in the external validator/publisher dependency chain.

evidence_items.summary: Active core resource/example sources include acme.com systems in built resources such as ValueSet and List.
evidence_items.learned: The resolution permits example roots and supports leaving these examples alone rather than converting them to real terminology systems.
